comments.name: Brian
comments.text: Verified manually via browser DevTools — POST /api/enroll returned 201 with registrantId and groupId.

acceptance: POST /api/enroll accepts: courseId, userId (from session), enrollmentType (INDIVIDUAL/ORGANIZATION), paymentMethod
Validate course exists and registrationStatus is OPEN or FEW_SEATS — 400 if not
Decrement quotaRemaining atomically (use prisma.$transaction with findFirst + update)
Create Registrant record in DB with paymentStatus: PENDING_VERIFICATION
For group enrollment (enrollmentType ORGANIZATION): accept registrants array with nameZh, nameEn, email, idDocNumber for each member
Auth check: only authenticated users can POST (use auth() from middleware/session)
Return 201 with { registrantId, groupId } on success
Error handling: return appropriate 400/401/404/500 with messages
verification: POST /api/enroll with valid courseId + authenticated session → 201 with registrantId. POST to full course → 400. POST without auth → 401. POST with invalid courseId → 404.
